identity.name: G-Shock 5600 Series Tough Solar JDM
identity.one_liner: The Japan-only GW-M5610U — the square 5600 case in Tough Solar radio-controlled, 200m water resistance, Multiband 6, at sub-$200. The cleanest G-Shock for daily wear.

provenance_events.description: Casio Japan releases the GW-M5610U as a Japan-only square G-Shock with Tough Solar, Multiband 6 radio control, 200m water resistance.

narrative.story: The GW-M5610U is the modern interpretation of the 1983 DW-5000C — the original G-Shock. The case is 42.8mm in resin, the dial is the classic 5600 black-on-white, the movement is Tough Solar (no battery changes) with Multiband 6 radio control.
narrative.collector_notes: The 3495 movement is one of Casio's most-cited: Tough Solar, Multiband 6, 200m water resistance, full auto EL backlight.
